title.zh: ⚡️美国通胀全线升温，市场加大对美联储加息预期
title.en: ⚡️美国通胀全线升温，市场加大对美联储加息预期

current_state.zh: US September CPI rose to 3.7% year-over-year with core at 2.6%, prompting higher Treasury yields, a stronger dollar, a gold and silver selloff, and increased market bets on three more Fed rate hikes by end-2027.
